Sam: Cutting an RC now — candidate artifact sha d4f5a2e. Need QA + sheriff signoff before any promo.
DeployBot: RC created: rc-2026-03-20-3, artifact d4f5a2e. Canary route ready. Preflight checks queued.
Maria: QA starting smoke tests in staging (kv warm + latency checks). Will report quick pass/fail.
Jen: Running eval harness against promptset/checkout-flaky. Will post numbers in ~10m.
Alex: Eng note: no infra migrations. Config change: feature.flag(new-kv-ttl)=off for this RC. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m holds.
Sam: Pin request: require sheriff + QA pass + telemetry gate green. Change window we want is 18:00-18:30 PT. Anyone object?
ReleaseSheriff: I can cover 18:00 PT. Rollback criteria: latency p50 > 200ms OR error-rate > 0.5% on model endpoints -> immediate rollback.
DeployBot: Preflight: schema_migration:none, db_lock:none, kv_warm:initiated, infra_health:OK, artifact_verified:true.
Maria: Smoke results: critical user flows pass. Minor noisy logs in generation worker (tracking), not blocking. Link: https://internal/reports/rc-2026-03-20-3/smoke
Jen: Eval results: 98/100 prompts pass. Two small regressions in formatting for legacy prompts; not blocking for this rollout.
Alex: Rollback plan posted: rollback target v2.7.0-rc2 (sha a9b3c1). Automated rollback script present: `/ops/rollback --to a9b3c1`. Call tree in doc.
Sam: Requesting to escalate to 25% after +15m if telemetry is green. Also locking artifact pin.
ReleaseSheriff: Approved for 5% canary. Hold 15m. If stable, green for 25%. If anything spikes, hold and/or rollback.
Ryan: Release notes updated: docs/releases/2.7.0.md — added known issue about embedding vector rounding on older clients.
Sam: Locking promo window. I'll trigger the DeployBot run at 18:05 PT if no regressions. Tagging @DeployBot :rocket: 
DeployBot: Promotion scheduled at 4321010700 (2026-03-20T18:05:00Z). Plan: 5% -> 25% (15m hold) -> 100% (after 60m total) with automatic rollback hooks. I will post status updates.
Alex: Throttling policy set to keep p95 latency stable across tiers; no routing changes.
Maria: QA final: thumbs up :+1:. Teams listed as rollback contacts: @Alex, @Sam, @ReleaseSheriff.
ReleaseSheriff: I'll monitor service health and telemetry. If p95 > 500ms or error-rate > 0.5% escalate and hold promo.
Sam: Thanks all — initiating cut and will watch DeployBot.
DeployBot: deploy job started: job_id=deploy-rc-4321009876-1. Logs: /ops/logs/deploy-4321009876.
Sam: Keep small notes in thread if you see anything odd (latency blips, cache misses, eval regressions).
Maria: Noted. Will post any anomalies.
Jen: Posting eval diff summary: small tokenization diffs, tracked in ticket #2345. No user-facing regressions.
ReleaseSheriff: Oncall to watch telemetry dashboard; I'll call if we need rollback.
Sam: Promo locked. Good to go on my side.
